description: Returns a link that opens a live spoken lesson with Kate, SpeakBase's AI speaking tutor, in the chosen language, optionally in a role-play scenario (job interview, ordering at a cafe, doctor visit, small talk at work and 40 more). Speaking happens on SpeakBase in the browser with a microphone; the first lessons are free. Also returns the scenario list.

native_language.description: The learner's own language as a two-letter code (for example he, es, ar). Used for explanations and for the language of the SpeakBase page the links open in.

scenario.description: A scenario id from the list in this description's result; omit for free conversation.

name: speak_with_kate
title: Speak with Kate
